termit.selite: The modelling software's own file format. Industry publications also use the synonyms native model and native file format.
Building Information Modelling, or the building information model of a construction project.
Industry Foundation Classes, the international standard for exchanging product data in building information modelling.
User Defined Attribute: additional information (metadata) stored on model objects in design software.

The term "Property Set" is commonly used in the construction industry. The Finnish original uses the Finnish term "Ominaisuusryhmä" to make the term easier to understand and to avoid a foreign-language term. Defining property sets precisely allows properties to be grouped into units that suit human readers. Using several property sets also avoids a long list of properties in a single "catch-all" property set.

The term "Property" is established in the construction industry. The Finnish original uses the Finnish term "Ominaisuus" to make the term easier to understand and to avoid a foreign-language term. Defining properties precisely enables a standardised data structure. A property is always attached to a property set.
